parsed.rationale: Both `AsyncNotificationMessage` (in `Shared/Core/Sources/Core/Observation/AsyncMessage.swift`) and `MainActorNotificationMessage` (in `Shared/Core/Sources/Core/Observation/MainActorMessage.swift`) are production interfaces in the same `Core` package with no restraint markers. They share three of three members — `name: Notification.Name`, `makeNotification(_:object:) -> Notification`, and a `makeMessage(_:) -> Self?` factory — differing only in the `sending` ownership annotation on the `Notification` parameter of `makeMessage`. Introducing a base PAT `NotificationMessage` with the shared shape allows the two protocols to refine it, each adding only the concurrency-specific annotation (`sending` for `MainActorNotificationMessage`, plain for `AsyncNotificationMessage`), eliminating the structural duplication while preserving the distinct concurrency contracts. The `Subject` associated type already appears in the shared `makeNotification(_:object: Subject?)` signature and is the natural PAT axis.
